lesson_section: 8.3 Responsible AI: How can I ensure my AI system is both secure and ethical?

normal.threat: Personal information could be exposed from the training transcripts.
normal.control: Remove direct identifiers and limit dataset access to approved staff because these steps reduce exposure of transcript data.
normal.residual_risk: Indirect identifiers may remain, and an authorized user could still misuse an accessible copy.

boundary.threat: Personal information could be exposed from the training transcripts.
boundary.control: Remove direct identifiers and limit dataset access.
boundary.residual_risk: Indirect identifiers may remain in the fictional dataset.

failure.asset: Fictional fraud-detection model and transaction review queue
failure.threat: Crafted inputs could evade the model and hide fraudulent transactions.
failure.control: Encrypt stored training data to reduce unauthorized access to that data.
failure.residual_risk: Evasion may still occur because encryption at rest does not assess the model's behavior on crafted inputs.
